folds.heading: ## Current authority and awakening seam, 2026-11-04 (B84)
folds.body: Preserve S1–S10 as independently selectable finite candidates, especially MI6-only versus the connected B12 rhythm, B14 A1–A5, B11 preparation versus full A3, and nonbiological successor routes that do not require reproduction or all earlier steps. Current generic awakening is imported from cheat_host; observeCheats captures a candidate, invokes the validated shared writer with state publication callback, then logs/refreshes after the writer returns. The old final render-before-save source statement is stale for that generic path. This source read does not establish CV1-specific bodyLens/evidence validation, fault recovery, acquisition or browser proof. Storage and timing targets remain engineering proposals: measure full retained envelopes with actual Unicode encoding, preserving identities and obligations rather than truncating valid lives to meet a soft budget. The one-realm milestone/1366 target are retired; current authority, compatibility decisions, AD36/AD43 and optional AD42 feedback govern a selected slice. No body schema, clinic, heir, genetics or cheat implementation is selected (AD32).

folds.heading: ## Current scope and selected projection seams, 2026-11-04 (B84)
folds.body: Retain AB1–AB12’s actual-consumer boundaries and original source fingerprints, without treating October 14 offsets or no-body-tab wording as a current UI census. The current status window mounts the shared You-sheet projection; that is a source observation, not CV1 diagnosis/bodyLens implementation. The current awakening owner is cheat_host through main’s alias and validated writer binding, as the [B16 correction](../b16/ROADMAP.md#current-authority-and-awakening-seam-2026-11-04-b84) records. Current selected knowledge effects still permit equal/higher-stage same-key replacement, requiring distinct actual observation/claim semantics for contradictions. Positive capability grants are not negative costs, contribution labels are not automatically public, generic custody/estate primitives do not settle every new carrier, and named consumers do not implement all proposed AB interfaces. AD51 governs shared seam design from known sources and second-world validation without imposing a two-implemented-world embargo. Current AD32/AD36/AD42/AD43 preserve proposal and proof scope; no new runtime or migration follows.
